target.statement: MPVM achieves ARI = 0.975 on the Raman spectroscopy cell-line clustering (3 clusters), beating CNM (0.969), t-mixture (0.972), GMM (0.825).
target.dataset: Raman spectroscopy single-cell data (LNCaP/H460/MCF7 cell lines, ~1080 observations)

compute.basis: No code released; the MPVM EM algorithm (with Cauchy scale-mixture E-step, trimmed k-means init via tclust, BIC model selection over G) must be re-implemented from scratch, and the Raman cell-line data provenance is unclear (likely from Matthews et al. 2015 / Harder et al. 2016, not obviously downloadable).

blockers: No code or supplementary materials linked
Raman spectroscopy dataset not clearly public/downloadable
Full EM implementation for MPVM must be written from paper equations
Comparisons require CNM (ContaminatedMixt), t-mixture (teigen), and mclust baselines
title: Robust model-based clustering via mixtures of multivariate pseudo-Voigt distributions
